title: Planned maintenance: NBN services connected via the Bendigo (3BEN) POI
current_summary: Planned maintenance is scheduled for the nbn Point of Interconnect (POI) in Bendigo, Victoria (3BEN). It will take place between 11:00 pm on Thursday 10 December 2026 and 6:00 am on Friday 11 December 2026 (Melbourne time). During this window, nbn services connected through this POI may be affected for up to 7 hours while an upstream provider upgrades a network device.

cause.reason: Planned device upgrade by an upstream network provider

updates.content: We have been advised that an upstream network provider will carry out a device upgrade at the Bendigo (3BEN) nbn Point of Interconnect. The work is scheduled between 11:00 pm on Thursday 10 December 2026 and 6:00 am on Friday 11 December 2026 (Melbourne time). Some nbn services connected through this POI may be affected for up to 7 hours during this window. We will share any further information as it becomes available.
